name: @dsh-toolset/auto-approve
description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）自动审批插件：在审批请求链上按名单 / 只读类 / 指纹 / 沙箱升级规则 / LLM 灰区审查自动裁定，免去逐次人工应答（未命中照常交人工面板）

scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf ../tmp/cov-auto-approve && mkdir -p ../tmp/cov-auto-approve && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=../tmp/cov-auto-approve node --experimental-transform-types --test 'tests/*.test.ts' 'tests/integration/*.test.ts' && node ../dev/coverage/report.mjs tmp/cov-auto-approve tmp/cov-auto-approve/report.json
